Kohoku Kogyo.why: Makes optical isolators, optical filters and composite / multicore-fiber optical devices for submarine-cable systems and optical components for data-center transceivers; its optical segment sales and capacity grow with submarine cable and data-center optical investment.
Kohoku Kogyo.evidence: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation 08-06-2026: Optical Components and Devices H1 sales 4,662 million yen (+25.2%); demand for optical isolators and optical filters for 2027 remains strong, capacity expansions at headquarters and Sri Lanka; demand for optical components for AI server optical transceivers continues to rise.

players.product: Optical isolators (compact and conventional), optical filters, composite optical devices and multicore-fiber FIFO devices for submarine-cable optical communications; optical components for data-center optical transceivers

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY12/2026 (January-June 2026): net sales 10,023 million yen, up 27.3% year on year, and operating profit 2,949 million yen, up 62.7% (operating margin 29.4%). Optical Components and Devices segment: net sales 4,662 million yen (+25.2%) and operating profit 2,400 million yen (+63.3%, margin 51.5%); Q2 segment sales 2,634 million yen, up 29.9% from Q1. Company: in the Optical Components and Devices segment, sales grew significantly across all customer segments in Q2, driven in part by the launch of new products.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales 10,023 million yen (+27.3%); optical segment sales 4,662 million yen (+25.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY12/2026 forecast revised up: net sales 22,238 million yen (initial forecast 19,613 million yen), +27.4% year on year; operating profit 6,754 million yen (initial 5,404 million yen), +46.1%. Optical Components and Devices: net sales 10,888 million yen (initial 9,257 million yen), +25.9%, and operating profit 5,575 million yen (initial 4,279 million yen). Assumes 160.00 yen per dollar for the second half. Company: driven by the prospect of expanding submarine cable projects, demand for optical devices is increasing and full-year sales and profits are expected to exceed initial targets.
quarterly_data.figure: FY12/2026 net sales forecast 22,238 million yen; optical segment 10,888 million yen

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: demand for optical isolators and optical filters for 2027 remains strong; it is expanding capacity at its headquarters (front-end) and in Sri Lanka (back-end). In response to increased orders from Q3 onward it is expanding production capacity at the Sri Lanka plant and adding semi-automated equipment; it will launch its third semi-automatic machine in 2027, is investing in front-end processing capacity for optical components, expects further sales growth in 2027 and is considering further capacity-building investments for 2027.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: the submarine cable market continues to see strong orders for optical components and devices on robust project investment, and orders for large-scale submarine cable projects have started. As submarine cables become multi-core, demand for conventional isolators is declining while demand for compact isolators and integrated devices is increasing significantly; the ratio of small isolators has risen to 80% (conventional types 20%). Demand for optical components for AI server optical transceivers continues to rise.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product timing: production and sales of hybrid (composite) optical devices have begun and increased significantly versus initial projections; modular components are still in sample evaluation and will go through life testing before production; FIFO devices for multicore fibers are to enter production and sales for land-based applications starting in late 2026; products compatible with multi-core fiber will go into production and be sold starting in 2027. The company plans to move its US front-end processing operations to its head office factory in September.
quarterly_data.figure: FIFO devices from late 2026; multi-core fiber products from 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex: increased production capacity for high-purity quartz glass and for optical components and devices for submarine cables; because part of the construction cost of the Maibara Plant (just under 600 million yen) will be carried over to 2027, planned capital expenditures were reduced from the initial budget of 2,177 million yen.
quarterly_data.figure: initial capex budget 2,177 million yen; just under 600 million yen carried over to 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo results presentation: Financial Results Materials Semi-annual FY12/2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lead terminals for aluminum electrolytic capacitors: the company estimates AI servers accounted for approximately 7% of its total sales as of June 2026 (approximately 3% as of March 2026); orders for hybrid conductive polymer capacitors for AI servers remain strong and it estimates its share in the capacitor market for generative-AI servers to be quite high.
quarterly_data.figure: AI servers approximately 7% of total sales (June 2026)
